_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The drawer header starts a new conversation at 1280px. The screen is already 1280x800 (do not resize it). A conversation exists at /c/{{SLUG}}. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 3. The drawer header's actions hold exactly four rendered buttons, in order "Search conversations...", "View options", "New Conversation" and "Collapse sidebar": eval JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('.drawer-header-actions button')].filter(b => b.checkVisibility({visibilityProperty: true})).map(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label'))) must return exactly ["Search conversations...","View options","New Conversation","Collapse sidebar"]. 4. Click the button "New Conversation" inside ".drawer-header-actions". 5. The URL should become /new (assert_url value "/new"). 6. The message input (data-testid "message-input") should be empty.
